observations.body: God does not lead Israel by the nearby Philistine road because the passage names war and a possible return to Egypt.
observations.label: The near way

observations.body: Israel is led around by the wilderness toward the Red Sea and goes up armed from Egypt.
observations.label: The way around

observations.body: Moses carries Joseph’s bones in fulfillment of the oath that Israel would carry them when God visited.
observations.label: Joseph’s bones

observations.body: Cloud leads by day and fire gives light by night so that the people can travel in both periods.
observations.label: Day and night

observations.body: The final line says that neither pillar departs from before the people.
observations.label: It does not depart

payload.posture: Keep the avoided route, the wilderness road, Joseph’s bones, and the cloud and fire in one movement.
payload.tension: The route named as near is not taken; Israel is led around by the wilderness while the cloud and fire remain continuously before the people.
payload.title: The near road is not taken
